It is an attribute of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and is mentioned in the Quran as the one who is purified and refined. The name Faseeh is also associated with the concept of Taharah, which means purification and cleanliness. In Islamic tradition, Faseeh is considered a name that reflects the qualities of purity, refinement, and cleanliness. It is a name that is highly revered in Islamic culture and is often given to children as a blessing. Faseeh is also associated with the Arabic word for 'light', and is often used to describe someone who is radiant and full of light. In modern times, the name Faseeh has gained popularity in many Muslim countries and is often given to children as a symbol of hope and purity.
